data.prompt: Create a photorealistic vertical 2:3 after-hours design-museum background plate only: quiet dim gallery, warm off-white walls, one small low travertine display block, one distant blurred classical bust, clear landing area for a four-inch object, generous upper-wall negative space, and one warm spotlight. No product, lamp, figurine on the plinth, person, hand, text, signage, logo, watermark, package, card, price, badge, CTA, border, collage, or theatrical display.
notes: The plate provides a small lit travertine contact plane, one secondary blurred bust, and ample negative space without a product or readable text.
